title: Check If Every Row And Column Contains All Numbers
description:
An n x n matrix is valid if every row and every column contains all numbers from 1 to n exactly once.

Return true if the matrix is valid, otherwise return false.

 
Constraints:

n == matrix.length == matrix[i].length
1 <= n <= 100
1 <= matrix[i][j] <= n
starter_code:
class Solution:
    def checkValid(self, matrix: List[List[int]]) -> bool:

check_function:
def check(candidate):
    assert candidate(matrix = [[1]]) == True
    assert candidate(matrix = [[1, 2], [2, 1]]) == True
    assert candidate(matrix = [[1, 1], [1, 1]]) == False
    assert candidate(matrix = [[1, 2, 3], [3, 1, 2], [2, 3, 1]]) == True
    assert candidate(matrix = [[1, 2, 3], [3, 1, 1], [2, 3, 1]]) == False
    assert candidate(matrix = [[4, 3, 2, 1], [3, 2, 1, 4], [2, 1, 4, 3], [1, 4, 3, 2]]) == True
    assert candidate(matrix = [[2, 3, 1, 4], [3, 1, 4, 2], [1, 4, 2, 3], [4, 2, 3, 1]]) == True
    assert candidate(matrix = [[7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1], [2, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 1], [4, 3, 2, 1, 7, 6, 5], [6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1, 7], [3, 2, 1, 7, 6, 5, 4], [1, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2], [5, 4, 3, 2, 1, 7, 6]]) == False
